run_webui_flask_server: run a Flask web UI server on port 7070 for Kronos financial time-series prediction
load_kronos_model: load a Kronos model (mini, small, or base) with tokenizer and predictor for financial prediction
predict_financial_data: predict future OHLCV price data using Kronos model with configurable lookback and prediction length
list_data_files: list available CSV and Feather data files in the project data directory
create_prediction_chart: create a Plotly candlestick chart comparing historical data, predictions, and actual values
